findings.passage: And when his friend Paloma Faith asked him in 2025 whether he was preoccupied with being good, his answer ended on safety.
findings.problem: His answer does not end on safety. In the episode (S40 24:00-24:40, inside the embedded clip; S24 c.0:24:50-0:25:30, re-transcribed), right after 'safety for yourself' he asks whether you can do that and 'remain authentic', answers 'Probably not', and closes on deciding whether 'allowing your true self to come out is the most important thing'. Safety is the stated aim of people-pleasing in his gloss, which the body describes correctly ('perception is the means and safety the stated end'). The hook's 'ended on' misdescribes the source, and a reader who plays the clip will hear a different ending.
findings.acceptance_test: The intro sentence uses an accurate verb, for example 'his answer turned to safety' or 'he named safety as what people-pleasing is for'. Optionally, one clause in 'Why not Type 1?' notes that he went on to weigh that strategy against staying authentic. C11b's passage is updated to match. No other change to the discriminator is needed.

findings.passage: for years he has described dreading being found out before each new job and leaning on people close to him to get there
findings.problem: In the type answer and the type FAQ, 'for years' grammatically covers both halves. The dread is documented in 2020, 2022 and 2024 (S27, S01, S15). Leaning on people close to him to get to work rests on one 2022 statement (S01), and the only off-stage glimpse (2020, begging Finlay not to come to Pass Over) is avoidance rather than leaning. The search-facing answer turns one statement into a multi-year pattern.
findings.acceptance_test: In both the type answer and the type FAQ, 'for years' scopes only the dread, and the leaning is dated or singular (for example, '...before each new job, and in 2022 said he needs people close to him to get there'). The answer stays at or under 60 words. C47's claim text matches.

findings.passage: He was born on June 11, 1990, at Guy's Hospital in London
findings.problem: The day of birth (FAQ and birth_date '1990-06-11') rests on S32 (Wikipedia), whose own citation for '11 June' is a TV Insider database page tagged 'better source needed' (May 2025). A TheWrap explainer in the research cache gives the same date, and every dated age in S01-S04 fits, so it is probably right. But the evidence record contains no independent source for the day, and the standard says to omit unsupported precision.
findings.acceptance_test: Either the evidence record adds an opened, independent source for 11 June 1990 to C01 (TheWrap or better), or the FAQ and birth_date drop the day and keep 'born in 1990 at Guy's Hospital'. The age FAQ stays consistent either way.
